name: New Zealand Rural Land Company Limited
quirks: CSV CapEx/FreeCashFlow are land acquisition, not maintenance capex.

Consolidates 100% of the Roc/NZ Rural Land Trust but only ~75% of AFFO is attributable: consolidated AFFO FY2025 11.014m vs NZL share 7.932m. Redeemable LP units 79.563m are excluded from TotalDebt (bank debt only) and sit in kpis as RedeemableLPUnits.
FY2021 is a ~9.5-month stub since the Dec-2020 IPO - CAGRs spanning it are meaningless.
Fiscal year end changed from 30 June to 31 December via a six-month transition stub (FY2022-6moStub, 1 Jul-31 Dec 2022); FY2021 and FY2022 are June years.
NetIncome is dominated by unrealised IAS 40 land revaluations - never use it as an earnings base. Revenue = rental income only.
Valued by AFFO/dividend capitalization at cost of equity with exit P/B, not owner-FCF DCF. Has never traded above 0.74x book since the Dec-2020 IPO.
